_comment: Go-specialist bottom-tier, HIGH cheap-tier fan-out (5:1:1). Tests the tension diagnosis from results/tension-diagnosis-2026-07-30.md: at 2:1:1 a single flaky-but-unanimous wrong answer (scale_chunk) sits at the 2-sample Wilson ceiling (0.425), indistinguishable from correct unanimous answers, forcing tau0=1.0 at alpha=0.05 and inverting the cost win. Raising tier0 to 5 samples lifts the unanimity ceiling to ~0.649 AND splits flaky clusters (samples disagree -> wrong-answer score drops), so a threshold below the ceiling can admit correct answers while rejecting flaky wrong ones. Success = a valid alpha=0.05 certificate with tier0 threshold < 1.0 and cascade cost < always-frontier. Tiers 1-2 stay at 1 sample to isolate the tier0 fan-out lever; prices identical to config.go-specialist-211.json so cross-run cost comparison holds. test_model=sonnet-4-6 differs from every tier (invariant #3).
